name: Converse with the hub in a plain terminal
principle: A person can converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks.
state_description: Each line a person types is answered, the work behind each answer can be seen on request, every question the hub asks is shown where the person will see it and answered by the next line, and the session ends when the person leaves. While the AI works, each piece of information has one home: the live area shows what is happening now (running steps, helpers, elapsed time, cost, a message not yet taken up) and the scrolling transcript keeps what is finished and worth keeping, so nothing is shown in both at once and no old frame stays above the new one.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted sessions: every turn is answered, every question is answered, the session ends cleanly.
